name: Jackson County, GA
findings: Jackson County has 222 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jackson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
